modifier_claims.support_quote:
Family history was notable for a daughter with similar facial papules that had not undergone biopsy.

Whole-exome sequencing revealed:    - A conserved splice-site mutation in SUFU gene (c.757-2A>G) in all tumor and normal tissue samples
multiple dome-shaped, skin-colored asymptomatic papules located on the face and vulva. The lesions first appeared around 50 years of age and gradually increased to approximately 60 lesions.

Medical history was significant for a meningioma. Family history was notable for a daughter with similar facial papules that had not undergone biopsy.

Whole-exome sequencing revealed:    - A conserved splice-site mutation in SUFU gene (c.757-2A>G) in all tumor and normal tissue samples    - Additional distinct deletions of the trans SUFU allele in all tumor samples    - No deletions present in the normal sample
